jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(2)(E) inventory: Winooski School District, an incorporated (city) district that is its own supervisory district (member: City of Winooski). Operates PK-12. Board fixed by its charter, 16 V.S.A. App. ch. 23.

board.post_note: Winooski SD: five trustees elected at large under its charter (16 V.S.A. App. ch. 23 section 23-2) -- three seats at 3-year terms and two at 2-year terms.

sources.note: Winooski SD School Board page (official, re-verified 2026-10-22): Mace (President) "3 Year Term Expires: 3/2029"; Millar (Vice President) 3-year exp. 3/2028; Essiba 2-year exp. 3/2028; Bowers 2-year exp. 3/2027; Livermore (Secretary) "(Interim/3 Year Term Expires: 3/2027)." The charter (16 V.S.A. App. ch. 23 section 23-2) fixes five trustees elected at large -- three 3-year seats and two 2-year seats -- matching the page's seat classes exactly, and empowers the board to appoint to a vacancy until an election fills the remainder. Livermore took Isaiah Donaldson's seat mid-term in fall 2025 (he is listed in the October 2025 newsletter; she attends from Nov. 12, 2025) and the district's own page still labels her Interim -- minted APPOINTED (interim), flagged; the exact missing document is the fall-2025 minutes recording the appointment (Sept. 29 special or Oct. 8 regular, indexed on the district's minutes page). Excluded: Allyssa Ravelin, the elected District Treasurer under section 23-3(2)(D) (a district officer, not a trustee), and two student members. Donaldson gets no ended record -- his departure mechanism is undocumented.

directors.name: Emily Bowers
directors.note: 2-year seat. Same person as the Winooski justice of the peace record.

directors.name: Katie Livermore
directors.note: Secretary; APPOINTED (interim) under the charter's vacancy power -- the district's own page labels her Interim. See the board sources for the flag.
